text: 9.	On April 18, 1942, just four months after the devastating attack on Pearl Harbor , 16 B-25 bombers launched from the aircraft carrier USS Hornet and struck the Japanese mainland for the first time in World War II. The bombers could not return to the carrier because B-25s were too heavy to land on a flight deck. The plan was for them to fly onwards and land at airfields in China. Most crews crash-landed or bailed out over Chinese territory; eight airmen were captured by the Japanese, three of whom were executed. The mission's commander X was a former racing pilot and aeronautical engineer who had been the first person to fly coast-to-coast across the United States in under 24 hours. X received the Medal of Honor and was promoted from lieutenant colonel to brigadier general, skipping the rank of colonel entirely. This “X Raid” did little material damage but was a massive psychological blow to Japan. So big was the morale boost in the US that a movie was made about this raid in 1944 in the middle of the war, starring Spencer Tracy as X. ID X (10 points).
